import sqlite3
import csv
import sys

def export_users_to_csv(db_path, output_file, username_filter=None):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # Build query based on filter if provided
    if username_filter:
        query = f"SELECT id, username, email, full_name, salary, role FROM users WHERE username LIKE '%{username_filter}%'"
    else:
        query = "SELECT id, username, email, full_name, salary, role FROM users"
    
    cursor.execute(query)
    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    
    # Write to CSV
    with open(output_file, 'w', newline='') as f:
        writer = csv.writer(f)
        writer.writerow(['ID', 'Username', 'Email', 'Full Name', 'Salary', 'Role'])
        writer.writerows(rows)
    
    conn.close()
    print(f"Exported {len(rows)} users to {output_file}")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    db_path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'users.db'
    output = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 'users_export.csv'
    filter_term = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else None
    export_users_to_csv(db_path, output, filter_term)
